high_level_description: stc brand style, a corporate event photograph of businessmen standing before a branded backdrop with two red podiums.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A modern conference center with visible ceiling infrastructure, track lighting, a polished reflective floor, and a white backdrop illuminated with purple and blue lighting.

elements.desc: Two Western men in business suits standing behind two bright red podiums in the center.
Several Middle Eastern men wearing traditional Saudi thobes and ghutras standing to the left and right.
Additional attendees and photographers partially visible at the edges of the frame.
A repeating logo pattern across the event backdrop.
A repeating logo pattern across the event backdrop, alternating with the other sponsor logo.
